name: ComputeLocalState
definition: A procedure to compute the local state (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, SKIPPED) of nodes in a hierarchical SDF tree relative to a specific cell, using Lipschitz pruning to determine which primitives can be safely ignored.
summary: ComputeLocalState determines node states in hierarchical SDF trees using Lipschitz pruning to cull distant primitives, differing from standard traversal by combining post-order evaluation with immediate state-based culling.
